info.name: Select Star Metadata bi comments API

params.name: commented_on
params.description:
Filter objects by commented_on. May specify __gt, __gte, __lt or __lte.

 API call to: 

 ENDPOINT/commented_on__gt=2021-08-04T15:12:40&commented_on__lt=2021-08-23 

 will result with objects commented_on after  August 4th 2021 at 15:12:40, but before August 23rd 2021. 

. If you want to include lower or upper bound of the range use __gte or __lte respectively.

params.name: order
params.description:
Specify the ordering for the results. 

 A comma separated list for ordering by multiple fields and a preceding `-` indicates reverse order. 

Note: Order is case-sensitive.

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: search_target
params.description: Filter comments by the commented object name.

items.docs: **Required Role:** Data Manager or Admin (or RBAC policy)
